department: Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences

deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications are due January 15, 2027 for both U.S. and non-U.S. applicants.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for Ph.D. in Environmental Sciences applicants.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores are optional for the PhD in Environmental Science Application.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Earth or Environmental Sciences.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to reach out to potential faculty advisors before applying for the Ph.D.
supervisor.quote: We strongly encourage applicants to reach out to potential advisors before applying for the PhD.

funding.value: The Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences Ph.D. pages do not state guaranteed funding or assistantship terms.

entry_route.value: Minimum entry requirement is a B.S. in any science or engineering program with an environmental emphasis.
entry_route.quote: Undergraduate Degree: Minimum BS in any Science/Engineering Program with an environmental emphasis.

ielts_min.value: The department page states a minimum acceptable IELTS score of 6.5 (lower than the Graduate School's general IELTS 7 minimum).
ielts_min.quote: The minimum acceptable IELTS (English proficiency) score is 6.5.

notes: Department entry page also notes legacy TOEFL iBT minimums of 94-101 alongside IELTS 6.5, which differs from central Rutgers-Newark rules.
name: Ph.D. in Environmental Sciences
